body.statement: Supporting corollary (Vovk--Wang arithmetic e-merging and the closed-testing principle): for every \(n\), every \(\pi_n\in\Pi_n\), and every \(\mu\in\mathbb R^K\), \(\mathbb P_\mu\{\mathcal R_n\cap\{j\in\mathcal J:\mu_j\leq0\}\neq\varnothing\}\leq\alpha=0.05\).
body.justification: This cited corollary records the confirmatory guarantee held fixed while recruitment is optimized; it is not a novelty-bearing result.
body.gap: Vovk and Wang establish arithmetic e-merging, and closed testing converts valid intersection tests into strong familywise error control; the displayed Gaussian specialization is a direct supporting corollary.
body.consumer: It lets rpact-style enrichment workflows optimize enrollment without recalibrating the declared threshold.
